name: Cretaaviculus
isnote: Known from a single asymmetrical contour feather; no analysis places it.
sum: Late Cretaceous bird known only from an asymmetrical contour feather from the Bostobe Formation of Kazakhstan.
holotype: An isolated asymmetrical contour feather from the Bostobe Formation.
material: Known only from the holotype feather.
biology: Not given in the sources used.
author: Bazhanov 1969
dates_note: No PBDB record; the Wikipedia revision says Upper Cretaceous Bostobe Formation; Coniacian–Santonian is not given there and must be checked.
